_note: For a first discussion with the utility board, local government, a lender or a donor. guidance_id: Indonesian wording for template placeholders, awaiting Silvia's review.

sections.guidance: Half a page: the utility, the problem, the selected actions with each action's expected reduction (tCO2eq) and energy saving (kWh) stated separately (combined savings have not been assessed because actions may overlap, so do not add them up), indicative cost and request.
sections.guidance_id: Setengah halaman: utilitas, masalahnya, kegiatan terpilih beserta perkiraan pengurangan emisi (tCO2eq) dan penghematan energi (kWh) masing-masing secara terpisah (penghematan gabungan belum dinilai karena kegiatan dapat tumpang tindih, jadi jangan dijumlahkan), biaya indikatif dan permohonan.

sections.guidance: Who the utility is, service area, population served, current service levels and climate exposure.
sections.guidance_id: Profil utilitas, wilayah layanan, jumlah penduduk terlayani, tingkat layanan saat ini dan paparan iklim.

sections.guidance: ECAM results: total and by stage and gas, assessment period, GWP report, grid factor. Only numbers from the results.
sections.guidance_id: Hasil ECAM: total serta per tahap dan per gas, periode penilaian, laporan GWP, faktor emisi listrik. Hanya angka dari hasil perhitungan.

sections.guidance: Each selected action: what it is, why (evidence from ECAM), expected result and assumptions, what still needs confirmation.
sections.guidance_id: Setiap kegiatan terpilih: apa kegiatannya, alasannya (bukti dari ECAM), hasil yang diharapkan dan asumsinya, serta hal yang masih perlu dikonfirmasi.

sections.guidance: Phases, timeline, owners, dependencies from the project plan.
sections.guidance_id: Tahapan, jadwal, penanggung jawab dan keterkaitan antartugas dari rencana proyek.

sections.guidance: Costs provided by the user only. If none, list what costing is needed.
sections.guidance_id: Hanya biaya yang diberikan pengguna. Jika belum ada, sebutkan perhitungan biaya yang diperlukan.

sections.guidance: How results are tracked: repeat ECAM yearly, metering, data owners.
sections.guidance_id: Cara hasil dipantau: penilaian ECAM diulang setiap tahun, pengukuran meter, pemilik data.
